description: State government permits data sharing of police cases with a state-owned company to use AI tools for analysis, enhancing law enforcement effectiveness and monitoring criminal offenders.
body_lead: MUMBAI: The state govt permitted data sharing of police cases with a state-owned company that will use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to analyze those data, enabling police to perform law enforcement more effectively and keep a check on criminal offenders. The AI tool will generate a comprehensive report on the provided data of any specific case, its insights, recommendations, relevant visualizations, or statistical summaries as required by the respective police unit.
